 raise form_trigger_failure ;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 h_where_clause varchar2(500) := ' 1 = 1 ';
 q_hit number;
 v_clause varchar2(300);
 v_clause1 varchar2(300);
 v_clause2 varchar2(300);
begin
 if :ctrl_block.start_date is null or :ctrl_block.end_date is null then
 go_item( 'ctrl_block.start_date' );
 show_error( '11300');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif :ctrl_block.start_date > :ctrl_block.end_date then
 go_item( 'ctrl_block.start_date' );
 show_error('11066');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.recruiter_id is not null then
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || 
 ' and recruiter_id = :ctrl_block.recruiter_id and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ';
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.status is not null then
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || 
 ' and status = :ctrl_block.status ';
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.type is not null then
 if :ctrl_block.type = 'M' then
 v_clause:= '('||'''I'''||','||'''C'''||')';
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause ||
 ' and drive_type in '||
 v_clause;
 elsif :ctrl_block.type = 'F' then
 v_clause1:= '('||'''F'''||')';
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause ||
 ' and drive_type in '||
 v_clause1;
 elsif :ctrl_block.type = 'ALL' then
 v_clause2:= '('||'''I'''||','||'''C'''||','||'''F'''||')';
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || 
 ' and drive_type in '||
 v_clause2;
 end if;
 end if;

 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || 
 ' and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and drive_date between :ctrl_block.start_date and ' ||
 ' :ctrl_block.end_date + 0.99999';
 set_block_property('drives', default_where, h_where_clause); 
 go_block('drives');
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := '25';
 count_query;
 q_hit := get_block_property('drives', query_hits);
 :ctrl_block.total_count := q_hit;
 set_ctrl_block('D');
 if q_hit > 0 then
 set_sort_buttons('E');
 end if;
 go_block('drives');
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := '10';
end;

Block.Name: DRIVES
Block.DMLDataName:
Select d.chapter_id,d.recruiter_id,d.drive_id,
 d.drive_date,d.drive_type,d.status,d.insert_date,
 Initcap(substr( s.name, 1, 30 )) spon_name,
 Initcap(rtrim(e.last_name) || ', ' || rtrim(e.first_name) ) recruiter_name,
 d.projected_show,d.projected_draw, d.event_id
 from drives d, drive_sponsors ds, sponsors s, 
 employees e
 where d.drive_id = ds.drive_id
 and ds.sponsor_id = s.sponsor_id 
 and e.staff_no = d.recruiter_id
 and d.chapter_id = ds.chapter_id
 and d.chapter_id = s.chapter_id
 and d.chapter_id = e.chapter_id

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_CTRL_BLOCK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE SET_CTRL_BLOCK( state IN varchar2 ) IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.RECRUITER_ID' then
 item_change( 'ctrl_block.recruiter_id', state );
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.STATUS' then
 item_change( 'ctrl_block.status', state );
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.TYPE' then
 item_change( 'ctrl_block.type', state); 
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.START_DATE' then
 item_change( 'ctrl_block.start_date',state );
 end if;

 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.END_DATE' then
 item_change( 'ctrl_block.end_date', state );
 end if;
 if state = 'D' then
 set_item_property( 'ctrl_block.pb_retrieve_info', enabled, property_false );
 set_item_property( 'ctrl_block.pb_recruiter_lov', enabled, property_false );
 set_item_property( 'ctrl_block.pb_drive_stat', enabled, property_false );
 else
 set_item_property( 'ctrl_block.pb_retrieve_info', enabled, property_true );
 set_item_property( 'ctrl_block.pb_recruiter_lov', enabled, property_true );
 set_item_property( 'ctrl_block.pb_drive_stat', enabled, property_true );
 end if;
END;

RecordGroup.Name: DRIVES_ALL
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select a.drive_date, a.drive_id, c.name from drives a, drive_sponsors b, sponsors c where ( a.recruiter_id = :ctrl_block.recruiter_id or a.recruiter_id in ( select sec_user_id from valid_user_privs where prim_user_id = :ctrl_block.recruiter_id and sysdate between eff_date and nvl( term_date, sysdate + 1)) ) and c.sponsor_id = b.sponsor_id and a.drive_id = b.drive_id and a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and c.name like '%' || :ctrl_block.drive_id || '%' and a.drive_date >= ( trunc(sysdate) - :global.lov_limit ) order by a.drive_date desc

RecordGroup.Name: RECRUITER_RG
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select staff_no, rtrim(last_name) || ', ' || rtrim(first_name) from employees where emp_class = 'RECRT' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl( term_date, sysdate + 1) and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
and (staff_no = :ctrl_block.recruiter_id
 or first_name like '%'||:ctrl_block.recruiter_id||'%'
 or last_name like '%'||:ctrl_block.recruiter_id||'%')
 order by last_name

-- Added by Kishore on 06/20/2012. IM 8497
DECLARE
 l_chp_id VARCHAR2(4);
 l_print_id VARCHAR2(40);
 l_error VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN
 populate_chapter_ID(l_chp_id, l_print_id, l_error);
 
 IF l_error IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF l_error in ('9776', '9777') THEN
 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF;
 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;

declare
 msg number;
begin
 select count(msg_id)
 into msg
 from alert_log
 where user_id = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid
 and read_date is null;
 
 if msg > 0 then
 set_item_property('toolbar.pb_alerts',label,'Msg: '||to_char(msg));
 end if;
exception
 when program_error then
 null; 
end;
